newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: GIB mandates Chase to manage $200 mln FRN.
newsitem.headline: GIB mandates Chase to manage $200 mln FRN.

text.p: Gulf International Bank said on Wednesday it had mandated Chase Manhattan International Ltd to lead manage a $200 million debut floating rate note issue on the international market.
The issue, which is due to be launched in May, will have a tenor of five years, GIB said in a statement.
"The pricing of the floating rate note is considerably lower than the two previous syndicated loans completed for GIB in the past eighteen months," it said, but gave no details.

GIB is a wholesale commercial bank based in Bahrain. It is wholly owned by the Kuwait-based Gulf Investment Corp, which in turn is owned equally by the six Gulf states -- Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Bahrain, United Arab Emirates, Oman and Qatar.
